description.value: Pizza Factory is a locally run pizza restaurant that has been serving the Langley area for 25 years, operating across multiple locations including Langley/Brookswood, Murrayville, and Cloverdale. The menu has expanded to 16 specialty pizzas with a notably broad range of vegetarian and Indian-inspired options alongside traditional meat varieties. Online ordering is available, making it convenient for a quick takeout stop on a cycling route.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wave (5 spaces) at 92m. Total: 5 spaces.

No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
